title: Renew a native animal keeper licence
summary: Learn how to renew your native animal keeper licence online.
intro: To keep native mammals, birds, reptiles and amphibians as pets, you need a native animal keeper licence granted under the Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016.
who_can_apply: You can renew the licence online after receiving a renewal notice in the mail.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew your native animal keeper licence.

faqs.q: What is required to keep native animals as pets?
faqs.a: You need a native animal keeper licence granted under the Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016.

faqs.q: How do I renew my licence?
faqs.a: After receiving a renewal notice in the mail, you can renew and pay for the licence online.

faqs.q: What do I need to renew my licence?
faqs.a: You need your licence number, your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details, and your payment.
